title: Картка польового дослідження
fields_and_relations: Програма з revision, маршрут із position, групи, мета, checklist.
required_interaction: Зміна програми не змінює використану версію старого сеансу; перестановка маршруту.

implementation.view_model: WF-01: scope, programme, route CRUD, team/functions, source notes and consent templates, typed checklist, exact-revision human readiness confirmation and contextual handoff
limitations: Local browser prototype; equipment checks are human-attested; no hardware diagnostics or shared backend.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
permissions: field.write or catalog.write in archive scope; vocabulary.write for terms
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
